observed: Compact upper rocky compound combines tall square crenellated towers, roofless ranges, open courts and exposed stairs; it is not a rectangular generic keep.
The chapel-like mass has a polygonal pitched stone-colored roof and a broad semicircular projecting end with a circular or annular top terrace.
Lower enclosure follows the sloping hillside, with multiple hollow semi-round towers and one taller gate projection; the wall climbs toward the main rock edge.
A separate slim rectangular tower stands between the upper entrance and lower enclosure. Large exposed rock formations sit beside the irregular upper perimeter.
